text:
Sam Chen: Heads up: kickstarting a joint perf/W sweep with AetherCompute. Main goals: maximize perf/W for our medium batch workloads, identify kernel tuning patches, and produce a marketplace-validated profile. @Bob (Aether) @Luis - Ops can you confirm stakeholders and lab readiness?

Bob (Aether): Thanks Sam. On our side lab is ready — 4x AC-XL nodes staged. Kernel tree is on ac-mods branch. We can stream telemetry. Who owns automation scripts?

Maria Gomez: I can own bench automation + the canonical workload set. Plan: lm-bench suite + 2 customer-like prompt families. Need a power telemetry schema and file naming conventions.

Luis - Ops: I’ll expose chassis power via IPMI and push CSVs to s3://redwood-partner/aether/power. Will tag files with model, seq_len, batch, kernel_tag.

Jin Park: We should test both fp16 and 8-bit PTQ. Also include the KV-cache prefetch patch. Target: aim for >=20% perf/W improvement vs our baseline.

Bob (Aether): Patch list ready — ac-kv-prefetch.diff, ac-pstate-suggest.patch. We can also test boot flags like 'intel_pstate=passive' if you want.

Sam Chen: Yes please. Maria add boot flag matrix into the runbook. Jin add quant profiles. Luis add alert if power spikes >5% over baseline during runs.

Maria Gomez: Drafting matrix now: batch=[1,4,16], seq=[32,512], quant=[fp16,ptq8], boot_flags=[none,intel_pstate=passive,ac_pstate_on]. Will produce CSV and push to S3.

integrations-bot: Created ticket INF-8241: aether-perfw-sweep — owners: @MariaG, @SamC, @BobAether. Link: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-8241

Bob (Aether): We can do a smoke this week. Proposed: Thursday morning PT. We’ll stream logs to the shared bucket and tag runs with run_id and kernel_sha.

Jin Park: Thursday PT works. For kernel tuning, include this tiny script in runbook to set governor and max freq: ```bash
echo ondemand > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu*/cpufreq/scaling_governor
echo 4000000 > /sys/module/ac_core/parameters/max_freq
```

Maria Gomez: Nice — I'll add that. Also we need the marketplace metadata: sample throughput chart, perf/W table, and a short description. Who drafts the marketplace blurb?

Sam Chen: Marketing will create the final blurb but we should provide two variants: a technical summary and a concise customer-facing paragraph. Bob, can Aether legal confirm logo use + PR notes?

Bob (Aether): Legal is looped in. They prefer a joint quote only after numbers are final. Logo OK. PR timeline: target ~2 weeks post-validation.

Luis - Ops: I’ll provision an ephemeral cluster, seed keys, and restrict S3 ACLs. Note: add integration role arn:aws:iam::123456789:role/aether-bench-access for access control.

Maria Gomez: Putting the runbook in repo: https://git.redwood.ai/aether-bench/runbook.md. Results will be written as JSON lines to s3://redwood-partner/aether/results/2390012345/ with telemetry and perf metadata.

Sam Chen: :thumbsup: Ok team — I’ll run a quick precheck Wednesday 09:00 PT. Please post blockers here before then.

Bob (Aether): Added one: we’ll validate thermal throttling thresholds. If temps >85C we’ll throttle and annotate the run.

Jin Park: FYI: if we see latency jitter enable kv_cache_safe_mode=1 as a mitigation param.

Sam Chen: Closing loop: agenda for Thursday smoke run — 1) precheck 2) baseline run (no patches) 3) apply kernel patches 4) quant runs 5) generate perf/W report and charts. Upload everything to INF-8241. See you Thursday.
